summary: The connected synthetic bridge workbench has clear controls and status, readable conversation and tool-result hierarchy, stable spacing, and restrained functional boundaries for this slice. This pass is limited to the supplied connected desktop capture and current source.

review_boundary.capture_origin: Coordinator-supplied local Playwright screenshot after code field cleared.
review_boundary.observed_state: Connected synthetic read-only workbench with transcript and inert link preview.
assessment: Connected status has textual and color indicators; refresh and disconnect controls are distinct and satisfy source-defined minimum hit height and action spacing.
Page title, connection section, session heading, speaker labels, tool status, target and result card form a readable hierarchy without visible clipping or overlap in the capture.
Section rules, assistant-side rules and the result-card outline serve separate structural roles; decorative nested card frames and shadows are absent.

Source contains narrow-screen layout rules, recovery messaging, announcements, focus targets, pending-control behavior and reduced-motion handling; these were not independently rendered across those states and widths.

evidence_limits: Only the supplied connected desktop capture was visually reviewed. Pairing, loading, failure, revocation, focus, hover, narrow viewport, zoom and dark states were not independently rendered or exercised.
Coordinator reports 14/14 plan-bound E2E tests passed; this reviewer did not rerun them.
Contrast values, screen-reader output, keyboard traversal and actual hit regions were not measured.
This pass does not certify the full product, security isolation, production deployment, parent BB verification matrix, real project data handling or SDK integration.
